description: Perchance plugin generator that lazily/synchronously downloads and compiles other generators' lists via the public getGeneratorsAndDependencies API.

internal-code.role: Plugin logic: the dynamicImport() function (sync/async/preload modes). This is the generator's main.pjs.
Documentation/landing page markup + inline <style>. This is the generator's index.html (body contents only in the live editor).

external-code.name: Perchance engine global: createPerchanceTree(code, {name})
external-code.note: Called in both branches of main.pjs. Provided by the Perchance page runtime, not by any file in this project.

external-code.name: Perchance engine global: window.moduleSpace
external-code.note: Import cache / registry of already-compiled generator trees.

external-code.name: GET https://perchance.org/api/getGeneratorsAndDependencies?generatorNames=<names>
external-code.note: Stable, backwards-compatibility-guaranteed endpoint documented in the source comments.

empty_category_notes.third-party-assets: None. No images, audio, models, shaders, animations or data files exist or are referenced. The only non-ASCII glyph is the unicode character U+2684 (die face-5) in index.html.
empty_category_notes.project-resources: None beyond the two source files. There is no src/ directory, no JSON data, no templates/prefabs, and no UI resource files.
empty_category_notes.build-config: None. No package.json, bundler, tsconfig, lockfile or CI config. The generator is authored and served directly; there is no build pipeline and no minification step.

zip_contents_recipe: Rebuild by re-writing main.pjs and index.html verbatim; nothing is generated or transformed.
